description.zh: 备份计划ID，可通过调用[DescribeBackupPlanList](~~2869825~~)接口获取此参数的值。
description.en: The ID of the backup schedule.

description.zh: 用于保证请求的幂等性，防止重复提交请求。
description.en: The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request.

description.zh:
指定预付费实例为包年或者包月类型，取值：
- Year：包年
- Month：包月
description.en:
Specifies whether to use yearly subscription or monthly subscription for the instance. Valid values:

- Year

- Month

description.zh:
指定购买时长，取值：
- 当参数Period为Year时，UsedTime取值为1~5。
- 当参数Period为Month时，UsedTime取值为1~11。
description.en:
The subscription duration of the instance. Valid values:

- If the Period parameter is set to Year, the value of the UsedTime parameter ranges from 1 to 9.

- If the Period parameter is set to Month, the value of the UsedTime parameter ranges from 1 to 11.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun dbs renew-backup-plan --backup-plan-id dbstooi01exxx --period Month --used-time 1 --client-token HKAJHFIUEQWBFIJSNFOIWHN --api-version 2019-03-06 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun dbs RenewBackupPlan --region cn-hangzhou --UsedTime 1 --Period Month --BackupPlanId dbstooi01exxx --ClientToken HKAJHFIUEQWBFIJSNFOIWHN
